dogecoin.text: @CrazyGabey Sounds like ur murdering the dogecoin short? The more hype these have, the faster they come down

A little word of caution with regards to dogecoin. When  hype hits the news and all of ur friends are holding and hoping for the "moon", things end very bad almost every time. The market does a good job collecting liquidity and tuition from those late to the party. My 2 cents. GL
